title: Dak Prescott: "Cowardice" to put blame for Sunday's loss on Brian Schottenheimer

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dak Prescott: "Cowardice" to put blame for Sunday's loss on Brian Schottenheimer
sources.description: The Cowboys blew a 14-point lead and lost at home for the first time in franchise history on Sunday, so quarterback Dak Prescott may have been understating things when he called it "one of the toughest" losses of his career.
